item.title: A wave of plastic-free coffee pods and machines
item.description:
📝 Keurig and Lavazza’s new pods ditch the traditional plastic cups for compostable coffee tablets. Caraway’s new machine uses traditional coffee grounds, but unlike a conventional drip machine, the stainless steel and glass machine doesn’t have plastic in its brew path. “We’ve heard clearly from customers that they want more sustainable products and specifically less plastic and plastic waste,” Drapeau told CNN.
🔗 Read more: https://www.cnn.com/2026/11/02/food/coffee-machine-plastic-free
